notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association inventory is sourced: tower, gone, coordinates. The record's kind, status and coordinates match the inventory; no correction. Searches found no construction, staffing or removal record. A search summary mentioned a 1989 Forest Service publication, Lookouts in the Southwestern Region, which may cover this site; not verified and not used. A records lead is the Pecos/Las Vegas Ranger District of the Santa Fe National Forest. Do not confuse with Barillas, which the same county list shows as standing.
